newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 19.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounded from a previous 3.11 percent plunge, rising 108.70 or 1.41 percent to 7803.36.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index plunged 29.73 points or 2.37 percent to 880.45.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.7900/50 a dollar at around 0032 GMT, flat from 2.7940 at its New York ending on Monday.
* In early trading, Tokyo, Sydney and Singapore markets were higher.

* Malaysian shipping and transport firm Konsortium Perkapalan said it plans to acquire a 35 percent stake in air cargo firm Transmile Air Services Sdn Bhd. Transmile Group Bhd is disposing its entire stake in Transmile Air.
* Tan Chong Motor Holdings' net earnings for the six months to June 30, rose 40 percent to 159.03 million ringgit.
* Property firm Land & General reported net earnings rise of 26 percent to 65.34 million ringgit for the first half-year.
